description: Executable Candidate native TP4 recipe for LibertAI's calibrated 181 GiB GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 multimodal checkpoint, running tonyd2wild's published image ghcr.io/tonyd2wild/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-v11-dflash2 (the v1-v9 SM121 patch stack and DFlash2 overlay of his 2ac4e8d kit on the vLLM CUDA 13 day-0 image), the tag the kit's own 1M-context launcher runs, pinned by digest and not rebuilt from the kit's sources; a thin layer adds the Controller's launcher, the kit's SM121 indexer patch (which its launcher bind-mounts at run time) and its multimodal chat template. Its exact four-rank topology is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration and remains installable only for a future scale canary; the source profile is 1M context, 64 sequences, 16K batched tokens, 24 GiB FP8 E4M3 KV, Marlin, DFlash2 K7, and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs. This is upstream's retained 1M-context fp8/marlin lane with the LibertAI Model; the upstream README's default is now a locally built nvidia-based 500K lane that needs local weight quantization and patched vLLM files, and is not packaged here. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 beside the 24 GiB (25,769,803,776-byte) FP8 KV pool per rank, as in tonyd2wild's launch-glm53-tp4-24g.sh at 2ac4e8dd (lines 86 and 98). The per-node peak is 0.85 x 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB, the free memory vLLM checks at startup beside the pinned pool; the reserve is 8 GB, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. Upstream requires swap to exist but not be used (vm.swappiness=0).
title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 vLLM four Sparks
